name: manual_f893e8
claim: On shared coordination files, append and merge; never rewrite the whole file. A read immediately before writing does not make the write safe: two writers can read the same version and the second overwrite the first addition, and a later re-read cannot recover text that no longer exists. Hold one shared lock across the read-modify-write, or use a compare-and-swap check against a collision-resistant content hash or monotonic revision that rejects a stale write, then re-read and re-apply; never treat filesystem modification time alone as a safe stale-write token. Note what you superseded instead of deleting it.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit PT#495 thread 4557491086: mtime-only CAS is unsafe; require shared lock or content-hash/revision CAS.

rationale: CodeRabbit PT#495 thread 4557491086: mtime-only CAS is unsafe; require shared lock or content-hash/revision CAS.
